task: can_reserve(used, requested, capacity): bool over unsigned 16-bit integers; empty request at capacity allowed; reject invalid domains and used above capacity
retrieval_feature_origin: operator-authored from task specification; available to both retrieval arms
analysis: report executable correctness, rejected syntax, complete outputs, selected lessons, and latency; do not infer a quality gain from one task
split: development transfer within a related semantic family; not sealed or family-held-out certification
evaluation_solution_policy: generated probe solutions never admitted or exported into the lesson corpus
success_gate: admission/revocation/cold retrieval proven; all three arms measured under the same model and output cap
promotion_gate: no adapter training or VSA superiority claim from this pilot
